Islands & water

Bukit Langkisau

Bukit Langkisau is known as a hill viewpoint offering a panorama of Painan bay and the surrounding sea. This page summarises stable access and season-dependent activities.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Position

Hill above Painan

Bukit Langkisau is in the Painan area and offers a view toward the bay and coast. From the beach, the hill is a bit inland, not at the water edge.

  • Reachable by vehicle from Painan.
  • Gives a different angle from Pantai Carocok.
  • Good for panorama photos and cooler air.

Activity

Paragliding & season

The hill is known as a paragliding point, but availability depends on season, weather, and operators. Do not assume paragliding is available every day.

Confirm activities

Ask operators or staff about the paragliding schedule before planning a visit around the activity.

Timing

When comfortable

Morning and late afternoon give clear views and cooler air. Bring a light jacket as hill wind can be strong.

Questions

Before you go

01Where is Bukit Langkisau?+

The hill is in the Painan area, somewhat inland from Pantai Carocok. Reach it by vehicle from central Painan.

02May I paraglide there?+

The hill is known as a paragliding point, but availability depends on weather and operators. Confirm the schedule before coming specifically for it.

03How far from Pantai Carocok?+

The hill is somewhat inland; we do not quote a fixed figure because routes differ. Ask locals or Painan staff.

04Is there a hill entry fee?+

Hill retribution policy can differ and change. Confirm on site.
